$comment: Fixed public corpus for the real-world validation phase. SELECTED BEFORE COLLECTING ANY REDUCTION RESULTS (16 apps on 2026-08-22; expanded to 19 on 2026-08-25 — juice-shop, outline, strapi — still before CVE-set population and before any hazard-domain analyzer result existed) to avoid cherry-picking. CORPUS v1 IS FROZEN as of the 2026-08-25 SHA pin: every entry carries resolvedSha (the exact measured commit) and shaProvenance. The 5 calibration entries are pinned to the commits recovered from the actual calibration clones, so the published 0% calibration numbers are exactly reproducible. ref stays the human-readable branch; resolvedSha is the pin — any future upstream change requires an explicit, separately-reported corpus revision, never a silent SHA update. category: target = the kind of app reducer intends to support (primary decision statistic per ADR-0006 is the median over target apps); control = deliberately difficult/negative-control (plugins, ORMs, native deps, dynamic loading) where honest low/zero reduction is the expected measurement. calibration:true marks the 5-project calibration round.
